description: Guide users through resumable, full-fidelity forging of ChatGPT project history and documents into a validated multi-volume Obsidian Vault.

defaultPrompt: Forge this project into resumable Obsidian Vault ZIP volumes. / 將此專案鍛造成可續作的 Obsidian Vault ZIP 分卷。
Continue from FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md and process the next source batch. / 從檢查點繼續處理下一批來源。
Build linked notes and export a Vault ZIP with merge instructions. / 建立關聯筆記並匯出含合併說明的 Vault ZIP。
interface.longDescription: EW Knowledge Forge guides users through complete-project knowledge capture without assuming ChatGPT can see every historical conversation at once. It processes one bounded conversation or document batch at a time, delivers validated incremental Obsidian Vault ZIP volumes, and creates a compact FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md that lets a fresh chat continue safely. Stable source IDs, knowledge IDs, coverage checks, and merge instructions turn scattered project history into one full-fidelity Vault. / 具象知識鍛造器不假設 ChatGPT 能一次看見所有歷史對話，而是引導使用者逐段整理對話與文件；每批交付可合併的 Obsidian Vault ZIP 分卷及可跨新對話續作的 FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md，以穩定來源識別、知識識別、覆蓋檢查與合併說明，逐步完成整個專案知識庫。

name: ew-obsidian-knowledge-forge
